verdict.rationale: Postmark's first-party docs describe webhooks for real-time event notifications. The evidence includes dedicated pages for the delivery and bounce webhooks and guidance on protecting webhook endpoints. The llms.txt adds AI-oriented TypeScript guidance on receiving webhooks, covering basic auth, IP allowlisting, payload validation, event parsing and idempotency. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook subscription, and explicit evidence of API-based (programmatic) webhook configuration.
